note: Common parts a homeowner may want to have on hand or check with the contractor. Links are amazon.co.za search pages, not products or prices; nothing is added to a cart or ordered.

HOME.GEYSER.name: Geyser drip tray
HOME.GEYSER.why: Catches the next leak before it reaches the ceiling.

HOME.GEYSER.name: Geyser thermostat
HOME.GEYSER.why: The usual culprit when the geyser trips or overheats.

HOME.GEYSER.name: Pressure control valve
HOME.GEYSER.why: Often replaced with a leaking or burst geyser.

HOME.PIPE_LEAK.name: PTFE thread tape
HOME.PIPE_LEAK.why: Seals threaded joints on taps and fittings.

HOME.PIPE_LEAK.name: Tap washers
HOME.PIPE_LEAK.why: A worn washer is the most common cause of a dripping tap.

HOME.PIPE_LEAK.name: Self-fusing repair tape
HOME.PIPE_LEAK.why: A temporary wrap until the plumber arrives.

HOME.DRAIN.name: Drain plunger
HOME.DRAIN.why: First thing to try on a slow sink or toilet.

HOME.DRAIN.name: Drain snake
HOME.DRAIN.why: Clears hair and grease further down the pipe.

HOME.ROOF.name: Roof sealant
HOME.ROOF.why: Seals small cracks around flashing until a roofer can look.

HOME.ROOF.name: Tarpaulin
HOME.ROOF.why: Covers a damaged section before the next rain.

HOME.ELECTRICAL.name: Non-contact voltage tester
HOME.ELECTRICAL.why: Check a socket is dead before anyone touches it.

HOME.ELECTRICAL.name: LED torch
HOME.ELECTRICAL.why: For working at the board in the dark.

HOME.GATE.name: Gate motor battery 12V 7Ah
HOME.GATE.why: A flat battery is the most common gate motor fault.

HOME.GATE.name: Gate remote
HOME.GATE.why: Replacement if the remote is the problem.

HOME.APPLIANCE.name: Fridge thermometer
HOME.APPLIANCE.why: Shows whether food is still at a safe temperature.

HOME.APPLIANCE.name: Fridge door seal cleaner
HOME.APPLIANCE.why: A bad seal is a common, cheap fix.
